body:
## Summary

`deepseek_nextn.py` hardcodes `quant_config = None` whenever the target model is `modelopt_fp4`:

```python
if quant_config is not None and quant_config.get_name() == "modelopt_fp4":
    logger.warning(
        "Overriding DeepseekV3ForCausalLMNextN quant config for modelopt_fp4 Deepseek model."
    )
    quant_config = None
```

That's correct for DeepSeek V3/R1 NVFP4 checkpoints, whose MTP head ships in BF16 — but **GLM-5.3-Flash NVFP4 ([LibertAIDAI](https://huggingface.co/LibertAIDAI/GLM-5.3-Flash-NVFP4)) quantizes its NextN layer**, and `Glm5NextForConditionalGenerationNextN` inherits this code path. The draft model is then built BF16 while the checkpoint tensors are FP4-packed, and speculative-decode boot dies loading the draft's experts:

```
FusedMoE _load_w13: The size of tensor a (4096) must match the size of tensor b (2048) at dim 1
```

Note it took `--speculative-draft-model-quantization modelopt_fp4` just to get a quant config to the draft at all (the draft doesn't auto-detect from the checkpoint the way the target does) — and then this override silently discarded it, which makes the flag a no-op for this case.

## Environment

- SGLang `0.0.0.dev1+gd6ab04bdf1`, image `lmsysorg/sglang:glm-5.3-flash-arm64`
- 2× NVIDIA DGX Spark (GB10, SM121), TP2 + EP2, `--moe-runner-backend marlin`
- `--speculative-algorithm NEXTN --speculative-num-steps 3 --speculative-eagle-topk 1 --speculative-num-draft-tokens 4 --speculative-draft-model-quantization modelopt_fp4`

## Fix that worked for us

Keep the quant config for the NextN draft (the checkpoint's own exclusion list still keeps norms / `eh_proj` etc. in BF16, so mixed-precision heads are handled by exclusions, not by nulling the whole config). With that one-line change (plus the exclusion-matching fixes in the issue linked below) the NEXTN draft loads and speculative decoding runs: single-stream 14.2 → 20.6 tok/s on our 2-Spark setup.

A conditional keyed on whether the checkpoint actually contains quantized NextN tensors (or simply honoring an explicit `--speculative-draft-model-quantization`) would preserve the DeepSeek behavior while unblocking GLM-style checkpoints.

## Corroboration

[0xSero/glm-5.3-flash-sglang-sm121](https://github.com/0xSero/glm-5.3-flash-sglang-sm121) independently patches `deepseek_nextn.py` for the same model.

Related: exclusion-list matching misses for this same checkpoint family — see companion issue.

comments.body: Companion issue for the exclusion-list matching misses on this checkpoint family: #36596 (also #36597 for NVFP4+EP and #36598 for the DSA-off assert — the full set we hit bringing this model up).

A code-level datapoint: this persists at the current head of PR #36507 (`033446bb05`), so the pending GLM-5.3-Flash support work does not resolve it either. `deepseek_nextn.py` there still carries the unconditional override in `DeepseekModelNextN.__init__`:

```python
if quant_config is not None and quant_config.get_name() == "modelopt_fp4":
    logger.warning(
        "Overriding DeepseekV3ForCausalLMNextN quant config for modelopt_fp4 Deepseek model."
    )
    quant_config = None
```

and the existing resolver upstream of it (`_resolve_nextn_quant_config`) only special-cases `quark`, passing `modelopt_fp4` through to the constructor where the override then nulls it. So a checkpoint whose NextN weights are themselves NVFP4-quantized, like this one, still builds its draft as unquantized modules and dies at weight load exactly as reported (the 4096-vs-2048 mismatch being the packed-uint8 halving). One adjacent inconsistency while in there: `lm_head` is constructed with the original `quant_config`, not the resolved one.

The override's assumption, that a modelopt_fp4 checkpoint ships its NextN weights unquantized, presumably held for the DeepSeek NVFP4 exports it was written against. Now that `_resolve_nextn_quant_config` exists, extending it to detect the quantized-NextN case and dropping the blanket override in the inner module looks like the natural shape for the fix.

title: [Bug] deepseek_nextn hardcodes quant_config=None for modelopt_fp4 — breaks quantized NextN drafts (GLM-5.3-Flash NVFP4 speculative decoding)
